tests.name: test_launcher_all_user_text_enters_request_boundary
tests.verifies: All text typed into LauncherWindow enters AstraApplication.handle_request as RequestEnvelope with origin=LAUNCHER

tests.name: test_launcher_natural_language_cannot_bypass_boundary
tests.verifies: Natural language greetings ('hello', 'hi', 'thanks') cannot bypass the ingress boundary; route through META_COMMAND

tests.name: test_launcher_suggestion_selection_enters_boundary
tests.verifies: Selecting a suggestion SearchResult constructs RequestEnvelope(origin=LAUNCHER) before calling handle_request

tests.name: test_launcher_compound_greeting_and_operation_becomes_operational
tests.verifies: Compound greeting+operation prompts fail-closed to OPERATIONAL_GOAL and execute downstream without being swallowed as conversational

tests.name: test_launcher_request_id_correlated_end_to_end
tests.verifies: A single request_id correlates from RequestEnvelope through REQUEST_INGRESS_CLASSIFIED and REQUEST_DOWNSTREAM_SELECTED

tests.name: test_semantic_neighbors_routing_matrix
tests.verifies: 20 varied semantic neighbors across conversational, computational, composite, and operational classes route accurately
